title: CellarTracker Bottle Status Mix
dataSources: CellarTracker bottles (`cellartracker:bottle`), Vivino wines (`vivino:wine`), spirits bottles (`spirit:bottle`), and wine tasting notes (`wine:tasting`).
app: CellarTracker bottle exports, Vivino wine scans, spirits inventory logs, and tasting note journals forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cellartracker:bottle
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(bottle_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the CellarTracker bottle feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `bottle_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces the overall mood of your CellarTracker bottle feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
